answer: New identities activate through apprenticeship: a zenith mentor takes at most three apprentices per epoch, locks a 60-credit vault bond on each, and the apprentice completes a voyage graded independently. Each apprenticeship is one ledger thread; one bond backs one thread. Slot fees: first 30, k-th 30+8(k-1), 1000th 8,022 credits. For 1,000 fakes: 4,026,000 in fees plus 60,000 locked bonds. A mentor-rental ring fails: rented mentors cannot teach the task, so graders fail the apprentice and burn the bond and right. An honest apprentice pays 30 once; the bond returns after a clean voyage.
